cvEn:
Yosef Shahar Sarter, son of Aliza and Robert, was born on 17 Tammuz 5691 (2 July 1931) in the town of Olovice in Czechoslovakia. At the age of eight he made aliyah to the country with his mother. He completed his primary schooling at the elementary school in Ginegar. He worked as an electromechanic. He was drafted into the IDF in June 1948 and afterwards served in the regular army with the rank of Lieutenant.

In the last year of his life he was in France, and when he left for there he changed his name to the Hebrew form: Shahar. While in France he never stopped longing for the country, especially for the Negev, to which he had been bonded in his soul throughout his years of service.

He was among the passengers on the El Al aircraft that was shot down by a hostile attack over Bulgarian soil on 8 Av 5715 (27 July 1955). He was laid to rest in a mass grave in the Kiryat Shaul civilian cemetery. He left a wife.
